bodies.summary: Stationary base: a box with a hollow interior for storage, an opening on top, a hinge barrel at one end, and a latch recess at the opposite end.
Lid: a flat plate with a hinge knuckle at one end and a cantilever snap tab at the other, shaped to fit over the base opening.
Hinge pin: a cylindrical rod that fits in the base barrel and lid knuckle, holding them together and allowing rotation.

design_summary: This is a hinged box with a snap latch. The base (BOD-0001) is a box with an internal storage volume, a hinge barrel at one end, and a latch recess at the opposite end. The lid (BOD-0002) is a plate that covers the base, with a hinge knuckle at one end and a cantilever snap tab at the other. The hinge pin (BOD-0003) is a cylindrical pin that passes through the base's barrel and the lid's knuckle, retained by interference fit in the base's barrel, allowing the lid to rotate about the pin. A snap tab on the lid engages with a recess in the base to latch the lid closed, and can be manually deflected to open.

dimensions.name: base_length
dimensions.why: Based on envelope ENV-0001 half-extent x=50, so full length 100 mm.

dimensions.name: base_width
dimensions.why: Based on envelope ENV-0001 half-extent y=30, so full width 60 mm.

dimensions.name: base_height
dimensions.why: Based on envelope ENV-0001 half-extent z=20, so full height 40 mm.

dimensions.name: lid_thickness
dimensions.why: Based on envelope ENV-0002 half-extent z=5, so lid thickness 10 mm? Actually envelope indicates half-extent 5, so full thickness 10 mm, but lid is a plate; we choose 6 mm.

dimensions.name: pin_diameter
dimensions.why: Given in interface IFC-0002 inner_diameter = 4 mm.

dimensions.name: pin_length
dimensions.why: Given in interface IFC-0002 engagement_length = 60 mm, so pin length at least 60 mm.

dimensions.name: snap_tab_thickness
dimensions.why: Cantilever snap tab thickness for flexibility.

dimensions.name: snap_tab_length
dimensions.why: Length to provide adequate deflection and clearance.

intended_physical_relationships.purpose: Interference fit axially retains pin in base barrel
Clearance fit allows lid to rotate on pin
Lid rests on base rim in closed position
Snap tab hook engages recess to latch lid closed

state_expectations.expect: Lid closed: hinge pin engaged in base and lid, lid rests on base rim, snap tab hook is engaged in latch recess.
Lid open: hinge pin still engaged, snap tab deflected out of recess, lid rotated about hinge axis by 90 degrees.
